articles.title: Fat Bear Week Returns: 16 Bears Battle for the Chubby Crown
articles.summary: It's Fat Bear Week in Alaska's Katmai National Park — a bracket-style contest where fans vote for the fattest brown bear. This year, 16 bears compete, including a defending champ with a healed broken jaw.

articles.title: Nene Royal: The 16-Year-Old Guitar Prodigy Who Conquered AGT
articles.summary: A shy 16-year-old from Thailand shredded her electric guitar on America's Got Talent and became the first Thai winner. Now she's got a million dollars and a rock album in her future.

articles.title: The Simpsons Season 38: Emma Thompson, Chimps, and a $200 Cup
articles.summary: The Simpsons returns for Season 38 with a children's-book parody starring Emma Thompson as a chaotic author. Plus: a baby chimp episode, a Nightmare Before Christmas horror opener, and collectible cups selling for $200.
